info.description: 5E Advanced Materials, Inc. is an exploration stage company, which engages in the provision of boron and lithium properties in Australia and the United States. It focuses on supplying boron specialty materials, complemented by lithium co-product production. The company was founded on September 23, 2021 and is headquartered in Hesperia, CA.
info.description_zh: 5E Advanced Materials, Inc.是一家處於勘探階段的公司，主要在澳洲和美國提供硼和鋰資源。它專注於供應硼特種材料，並輔以鋰副產品生產。該公司成立於2021年9月23日，總部位於加州希斯皮里亞。

info.description: MaxLinear, Inc. engages in the provision of communications systems-on-chip (SoC) solutions used in broadband, mobile and wireline infrastructure, data center, and industrial and multi-market applications. Its products include cable broadband modems and gateways, wireline connectivity devices, radio frequency transceivers, fiber-optic modules, video set-top boxes and gateways, hybrid analog and digital televisions, direct broadcast satellite outdoor and indoor units, and power management and interface products. The company was founded by Kimihiko Imura, Curtis C. Ling, and Kishore V. Seendripu on September 25, 2003 and is headquartered in Carlsbad, CA.

info.description: Twist Bioscience Corp. engages in the development of a proprietary semiconductor-based synthetic DNA manufacturing process. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The Americas segment consists of the United States of America, Canada, Mexico, and South America. The EMEA segment includes Europe, Middle East, and Africa. The APAC segment focuses on Japan, China, South Korea, India, Singapore, Malaysia, and Australia. The company was founded by William Marine Banyai, Emily Marine Leproust, and Bill James Peck in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Twist Bioscience Corp. 致力於開發基於半導體的專有合成 DNA 製造流程。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲和亞太地區。美洲部分包括美國、加拿大、墨西哥和南美洲。歐洲、中東和非洲地區包括歐洲、中東和非洲。亞太地區市場主要集中在日本、中國、韓國、印度、新加坡、馬來西亞和澳洲。該公司由 William Marine Banyai、Emily Marine Leproust 和 Bill James Peck 於 2013 年創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Coffee Holding Co., Inc. engages in the wholesale of coffee roasters. Its products include Wholesale Green Coffee, Private Label Coffee, and Branded Coffee. The company was founded by Sterling A. Gordon in 1971 and is headquartered in Staten Island, NY.

info.description: Riverview Bancorp, Inc. operates as a holding company. It provides community banking services to small and medium size businesses, professionals, and individuals. It offers a range of deposit products, including demand deposits, negotiable order of withdrawal accounts, money market accounts, savings accounts, certificates of deposit, and retirement savings plans. The company also provides commercial business, commercial real estate, other real estate mortgage, and real estate construction loans, and consumer loans, such as one-to-four family mortgage loans, home equity lines of credit, land loans, and other secured and unsecured consumer loans. In addition, it is involved in the provision of brokerage and mortgage loan servicing activities, as well as offering asset management services consisting of trust, estate planning, and investment management services. The company was founded on June 23, 1997 and is headquartered in Vancouver, WA.

Illumina, Inc. engages in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of life science tools and integrated systems for large-scale analysis of genetic variation and function. The company was founded by David R. Walt, John R. Stuelpnagel, Anthony W. Czarnik, Lawrence A. Bock, and Mark S. Chee in April 1998 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Illumina, Inc. 從事生命科學工具和整合系統的開發、製造和行銷，用於大規模遺傳變異和功能分析。該公司由 David R. Walt、John R. Stuelpnagel、Anthony W. Czarnik、Lawrence A. Bock 和 Mark S. Chee 於 1998 年 4 月創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: YieldMax Short N100 Option Income Strategy ETF seeks current income; with secondary investment objective being inverse exposure to the performance of the Nasdaq 100 Index, subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks current income while providing indirect inverse exposure tothe performance of the index. Its potential for gains from decreases in the index level is limited. The fund is non-diversified.

Pioneer Power Solutions, Inc. engages in designing, manufacturing, integrating, and selling distributed energy resources, on site and mobile power generation equipment, and a platform of mobile electric vehicle charging solutions. It operates through the Critical Power Solutions segment. The Critical Power Solutions segment engages in the provision of mobile EV charging solutions, power generation equipment and all forms of services, preventative maintenance, repairs, fuel polishing, and remote monitoring. The company was founded on September 16, 2008 and is headquartered in Fort Lee, NJ.

Acorn Energy, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of technology driven solutions for energy infrastructure asset management. It operates through the Power Generation (PG) and Cathodic Protection (CP) segments. The PG segment offers wireless remote monitoring and control systems and services for critical assets, as well as Internet of Things (IoT) applications. The CP segment includes remote monitoring of cathodic protection systems on gas pipelines for gas utilities and pipeline companies. The company was founded by George Morgenstern in 1986 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Acorn Energy, Inc.是一家控股公司，致力於為能源基礎設施資產管理提供技術驅動的解決方案。它透過發電（PG）和陰極保護（CP）部門運作。 PG 部門為關鍵資產以及物聯網 (IoT) 應用提供無線遠端監控和控制系統及服務。陰極保護領域包括為天然氣公用事業公司和管道公司提供天然氣管道陰極保護系統的遠端監控。該公司由 George Morgenstern 於 1986 年創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Myriad Genetics, Inc. is a molecular diagnostics and precision medicine company committed to advancing health and well-being for all. It develops and commercializes molecular tests that help patients and providers uncover genetic insights. The company was founded by Walter A. Gilbert, Mark H. Skolnick, and Peter D. Meldrum in May 1991 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Myriad Genetics, Inc. 是一家分子診斷和精準醫療公司，致力於促進所有人的健康和福祉。它開發分子測試並將其商業化，幫助患者和提供者揭示遺傳見解。該公司由 Walter A. Gilbert、Mark H. Skolnick 和 Peter D. Meldrum 於 1991 年 5 月創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Vital Farms, Inc. packages, markets and distributes pasture-raised shell eggs, pasture-raised butter and other products. Its products are sold under the trade names Vital Farms, Alfresco Farms, Lucky Ladies and RedHill Farms, primarily to retail foodservice channels. The company was founded by Catherine Stewart, Matthew O'Hayer and Jason Jones in 2007 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.

Micware Co. Ltd. engages in software development services and innovative IT solutions mainly focused on the automotive and mobility sectors. It operates through the following segments: Software Defined Vehicles (SDV), Location-Based Services (LBS), and Others. The SDV segment relates to the development and sale of software systems designed for SDV, including IVI system software and other mobility-enhancing software products, conducted by its Japanese subsidiaries. The LBS segment covers the development and licensing of in-vehicle navigation software systems, and other geographic data-based services for business-to-business customers, mainly serving end users. The Other segment comprises software development services conducted by overseas subsidiaries designed for SDV, and business-to-consumer mobile app services unrelated to in-vehicle navigation. The company was founded by Kenji Narishima in March 2003 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

Cohu, Inc. engages in the provision of back-end semiconductor equipment and services. It offers test and handling capital equipment, interface products, and related services to the semiconductor and electronics manufacturing industries. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Cohu, Inc. 從事提供後端半導體設備和服務。它為半導體和電子製造業提供測試和處理資本設備、介面產品以及相關服務。該公司成立於 1947 年，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Fortrea Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of clinical development and commercialization services. It operates under the Clinical Services and Enabling Services Segments. The Clinical Services segment provides services across the clinical pharmacology, clinical development, and other clinical service spectrum utilizing enabling services and technology through multiple delivery models. The Enabling Services segment provides technology solutions directly to customers that streamline complex randomization and optimize the trial drug supply process, while minimizing operational costs and supporting timely and accurate patient dosing. The company was founded on January 31, 2023 and is headquartered in Durham, NC.
info.description_zh: Fortrea Holdings, Inc. 從事提供臨床開發和商業化服務。它在臨床服務和支援服務部門下運作。臨床服務部門透過多種交付模式利用支援服務和技術提供跨臨床藥理學、臨床開發和其他臨床服務範圍的服務。賦能服務部門直接向客戶提供技術解決方案，簡化複雜的隨機化並優化試驗藥物供應流程，同時最大限度地降低營運成本並支援及時、準確的患者給藥。該公司成立於2023年1月31日，總部位於北卡羅來納州達勒姆。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Technology ETF is an income-oriented investment strategy designed to maximize weekly distributions primarily through an options-based strategy of selling short-term put options on leveraged exchange-traded funds that track three times the daily performance of its underlying sector benchmark. The fund aims to capture three times the premium income generated from standard option writing on the sector index, pairing high yield potential with secondary, capped capital appreciation and a discretionary downside protection element.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Technology ETF 是一種以收入為導向的投資策略，旨在主要透過基於期權的策略來最大化每週分配，即出售槓桿交易所交易基金的短期看跌期權，該基金追踪其基礎行業基準日表現的三倍。該基金的目標是獲取行業指數標準選擇權寫作所產生的三倍溢價收入，將高收益潛力與二級資本增值上限和可自由支配的下行保護要素相結合。

info.description: Invest Green Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded by Matthew Kiernan and Andrew McLean on April 7, 2025 and is headquartered in Camas, WA.
info.description_zh: Invest Green Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司營運。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業或實體合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Matthew Kiernan 和 Andrew McLean 於 2025 年 4 月 7 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州卡馬斯。

info.description: ImmunityBio, Inc. is a clinical stage immunotherapy company. It develops next generation therapies that drive immunogenic mechanisms for defeating cancers and infectious diseases. The company's immunotherapy platform activates both the innate and adaptive immune systems to create long term immunological memory. ImmunityBio was founded by Patrick Soon-Shiong in 2014 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: ImmunityBio, Inc.是一家臨床階段免疫療法公司。它開發下一代療法，驅動免疫原性機制來戰勝癌症和傳染病。該公司的免疫治療平台可激活先天性和適應性免疫系統，以創建長期免疫記憶。 ImmunityBio 由 Patrick Soon-Shiong 於 2014 年創立，總部位於加州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Xtrackers Cybersecurity Select Equity ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Cyber Security ESG Screened Index. The fund, using a "passive" or indexing investment approach, seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the underlying index, which is comprised of companies that have business operations in the field of cybersecurity and that fulfill certain sustainability criteria. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers Cyber​​security Select Equity ETF 尋求與 Solactive Cyber​​ Security ESG 篩選指數（未計費用和開支）的表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金採用「被動」或指數化投資方法，尋求與相關指數（扣除費用和開支之前）的表現大致相對應的投資結果，該指數由在網路安全領域開展業務並滿足某些可持續性標準的公司組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Generac Holdings, Inc. engages in the business of designing and manufacturing energy technology solutions. It operates under the Domestic and International segments. The Domestic segment includes the legacy Generac business and the acquisitions that are based in the United States and Canada. The International segment focuses on Generac business' Latin American export operations. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Waukesha, WI.

Altria Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the manufacture and sale of cigarettes in the United States. It operates through the following segments: Smokeable Products, Oral Tobacco Products, E-Vapor Products and All Other. The Smokeable Products segment consists of cigarettes manufactured and sold by PM USA, and machine-made large cigars and pipe tobacco manufactured and sold by Middleton. The Oral Tobacco Products segment includes MST products manufactured and sold by USSTC, and oral nicotine pouches manufactured and sold by Helix. The E-Vapor Products segment contracts with third-party importers to supply all of its products and sells its e-vapor products to customers in the United States. The All Other segment refers to the financial results of NJOY, Helix ROW, and the IQOS System heated tobacco business. The company was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Richmond, VA.

GraniteShares Autocallable COIN ETF seeks to generate current monthly income while providing limited downside protection by investing in a laddered, rolling portfolio of single-stock autocallable option-linked derivatives. The fund executes its defined-income strategy primarily through over-the-counter or exchange-traded derivatives that utilize the common stock of Coinbase Global, Inc. as their single reference asset.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares Autocallable COIN ETF 旨在透過投資單股可自動贖回選擇權掛鉤衍生性商品的階梯式滾動投資組合，在產生當前每月收入的同時提供有限的下行保護。該基金主要透過場外交易或交易所交易的衍生性商品來執行其固定收益策略，這些衍生性商品利用 Coinbase Global, Inc. 的普通股作為其單一參考資產。

info.description: Chenghe Acquisition III Co. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 4, 2024 and is headquartered in Singapore.

CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and Ethereum 75/25 Strategy ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 and S&P Ether Futures 75/25 Blend Index. The index measures the weighted return performance of a multi-asset strategy that consists of a 75% weight in the S&P 500 Index and a 25% weight in the S&P Ether Futures Index. The fund will invest approximately 75% of its assets in the stock of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and will invest in Ether futures contracts so that the total value of the Ether to which the fund has economic exposure is approximately 25% of the assets of the fund.
info.description_zh: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 和以太坊 75/25 策略 ETF 力求在扣除費用和開支之前複製 S&P 500 和 S&P 以太期貨 75/25 混合指數的總回報。該指數衡量多元資產策略的加權回報表現，其中標普 500 指數權重為 75%，標普以太期貨指數權重為 25%。該基金將把約75%的資產投資於構成標準普爾500指數的美國大型公司的股票，並將投資於以太坊期貨合約，以便該基金所擁有的經濟風險敞口的以太幣總價值約佔該基金資產的25%。

info.description: Future Money Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of entering into a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 29, 2025 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Future Money Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月29日，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: FormFactor, Inc. engages in the provision of test and measurement solutions. It operates through the Probe Cards and Systems segments. The Probe Cards segment consists of technologies and product architectures, including micro-electromechanical systems technologies. The Systems segment consists of analytical probe solutions for on-wafer probing, board tests, and package tests. The company was founded by Igor Khandros on April 15, 1993 and is headquartered in Livermore, CA.
info.description_zh: FormFactor, Inc. 致力於提供測試和測量解決方案。它透過探針卡和系統部門運作。探針卡部分由技術和產品架構組成，包括微機電系統技術。系統部門包括用於晶圓探測、電路板測試和封裝測試的分析探針解決方案。該公司由 Igor Khandros 於 1993 年 4 月 15 日創立，總部位於加州利弗莫爾。

info.description: GP-Act III Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company, which was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 23, 2020 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: GP-Act III Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運營，其創建目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2020年11月23日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Globa Terra Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on October 18, 2024 and is headquartered in Mexico City.

info.description: Home Federal Bancorp, Inc. of Louisiana is a holding company, which provides financial services to individuals, corporate entities, and other organizations. It provides services through the origination of loans and the acceptance of deposits in the form of passbook savings, certificates of deposit, and demand deposit accounts. The company was founded on April 1, 1924 and is headquartered in Shreveport, LA.
info.description_zh: 路易斯安那州 Home Federal Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，為個人、企業實體和其他組織提供金融服務。它透過發放貸款和接受存摺儲蓄、存款證和活期存款帳戶形式的存款來提供服務。該公司成立於 1924 年 4 月 1 日，總部位於路易斯安那州什里夫波特。

info.description: HIVE Digital Technologies Ltd. engages in building a bridge between the digital currency and blockchain sector and traditional capital markets. The firm operates data centers for computing and mining cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin and other coins. It owns and operates green energy-powered data center facilities in Canada, Sweden, and Iceland. The company was founded on June 24, 1987 and is headquartered in San Antonio, TX.

HomesToLife Ltd. engages in the retail of home furniture and sale of customized furniture solutions. It operates through the following business segments: Retail, Export sales and Leather Trading. The Retail segment includes the results of operations of HTL SG and HTLK. The Export Sales segment includes the results of operations of HTL FE, HTLF, HTLA, HTLJ, HTLUK, and HTL Marketing in relation to export sales. The Leather Trading segment includes the results of operations of HTL Marketing in relation to leather trading. The company was founded by Yong Pin Phua and Yong Tat Phua in September 1989 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: HomesToLife Ltd. 從事家居家具零售和訂製家具解決方案銷售。它透過以下業務部門運作：零售、出口銷售和皮革貿易。零售部門包括 HTL SG 和 HTLK 的營運表現。出口銷售部門包括 HTL FE、HTLF、HTLA、HTLJ、HTLUK 和 HTL Marketing 與出口銷售相關的營運績效。皮革貿易部門包括 HTL Marketing 與皮革貿易相關的營運績效。該公司由Yong Pin Phua 和Yong Tat Phua 於1989 年9 月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Seastar Medical Holding Corp. operates as a holding company whose subsidiaries manufacture and supply medical devices. The company was founded on June 6, 2007 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.

ChipMOS Technologies, Inc. provides total semiconductor testing and packaging solutions to fabless companies, integrated device manufacturers (IDM) and foundries. It operates through the segment Testing, Assembly, Crystal Display and other Flat-Panel Display Driver Semiconductors (LCDD), Bumping, and Others. The company was founded on July 28, 1997 and is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

ioneer Ltd. engages in mineral exploration. It focuses on the development of the Rhyolite Ridge project. It operates through the North America and Australia geographical segments. The company was founded by Bernard Anthony Rowe on October 26, 2001 and is headquartered in North Sydney, Australia.

GraniteShares 2x Long ISRG Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Intuitive Surgical, Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the Underlying Stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options Underlying Stock as well as directly purchasing the Underlying Stock. The fund will aim to primarily obtain its notional exposure against the Underlying Stock through swap agreements.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long ISRG Daily ETF 在尋求扣除費用和開支之前，Intuitive Surgical, Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買基礎股票來複製基礎股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金的目標主要是透過掉期協議獲得其標的股票的名義曝險。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long MARA Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of MARA Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: MARA). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.

Single-stock leveraged ETF that seeks daily investment results of 2x (200%) the daily price performance of Hyperliquid Strategies Inc (PURR) common stock, before fees and expenses. Advised by Tidal Investments LLC.

info.description: Riot Platforms, Inc. is a bitcoin mining company, which engages in the provision of special cryptocurrency mining computers. It invests in Verady, Coinsquare, and Tess. It operates through the Bitcoin Mining and Engineering segments. The Bitcoin Mining segment focuses on maximizing ability to successfully mine Bitcoin by growing hash rate. The Engineering segment designs and manufactures power distribution equipment and custom engineered electrical products that provides them the ability to vertically integrate many of the critical electrical components and engineering service. The company was founded on July 24, 2000 and is headquartered in Castle Rock, CO.

2x Solana ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of SOL. The fund is an ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily through managed exposure to SOL futures contracts that trade only on an exchange registered with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, and cash, cash-like instruments or high-quality securities that serve as collateral to the fund's investments in Solana futures contracts. The fund is non-diversified.

Canary Staked SUI ETF is a spot digital asset exchange-traded product that provides regulated exposure to the price of SUI, the native token of the Sui Layer-1 blockchain, while simultaneously participating in the network's proof-of-stake validation process. The fund enables investors to capture both the price performance of SUI and net in-kind staking rewards, which are reflected in the fund's net asset value (NAV) without the need for direct digital wallet management.
info.description_zh: Canary Staked SUI ETF 是一種現貨數位資產交易所交易產品，提供受監管的 SUI（Sui Layer-1 區塊鏈的原生代幣）價格曝險，同時參與網路的權益證明驗證過程。該基金使投資者能夠捕獲 SUI 的價格表現和淨實物質押獎勵，這些獎勵反映在基金的資產淨值（NAV）中，而無需直接數位錢包管理。

info.description: 21Shares Active Crypto ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that primarily invests in a diversified selection of digital assets and related instruments to achieve total return based on active market repositioning. The strategy utilizes a systematic screening framework requiring underlying tokens to possess a minimum 12-month trading history, a $25 million average daily trading volume over the trailing 30 days, and active quotation across at least three distinct marketplaces, while explicitly prohibiting exposure to speculative meme tokens lacking fundamental functional utility.

Bloomia Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of in-store and digital advertising solutions. It serves the consumer-packaged goods (CPG) manufacturers, retailers, shopper marketing agencies, and brokerages markets. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.

Vicor Corp. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and marketing of modular power components. The firm provides complete power systems based upon a portfolio of patented technologies. Its products include AC-DC converters, power systems, and accessories. The company was founded by Patrizio Vinciarelli in 1981 and is headquartered in Andover, MA.

GraniteShares YieldBOOST Ether ETF is an actively managed fund that employs a synthetic income-generation strategy by selling put options on leveraged exchange-traded funds linked to the daily performance of Ether. The fund seeks to achieve 200% of the income derived from standard option strategies on the reference asset while maintaining exposure to the underlying leveraged instrument, albeit constrained by a cap on potential capital appreciation.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST 以太 ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過出售與以太每日表現掛鉤的槓桿交易所交易基金看跌期權，採用合成創收策略。該基金力求實現參考資產的標準選擇權策略所產生的 200% 的收入，同時保持對基礎槓桿工具的曝險，儘管受到潛在資本增值上限的限制。

info.description: Xometry, Inc. offers an AI-powered marketplace, the popular Thomasnet industrial sourcing platform, and a suite of cloud-based services. Xometry's marketplaces use proprietary AI to help buyers efficiently source custom-manufactured parts and assemblies and attain instant pricing and lead times. The AI enables a rapidly growing network of manufacturers to select the optimal jobs to fill capacity. The firm's suite of cloud-based services and Thomasnet industrial sourcing platform help manufacturers and industrial service providers grow businesses using advertising, marketing, and financial services. It operates through the following geographical segments: the United States and International. The company was founded by Laurence Zuriff and Randolph Altschuler in 2013 and is headquartered in North Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: Xometry, Inc. 提供人工智慧驅動的市場、受歡迎的 Thomasnet 工業採購平台以及一套基於雲端的服務。 Xometry 的市場使用專有的人工智慧來幫助買家有效地購買客製化製造的零件和組件，並獲得即時定價和交貨時間。人工智慧使快速成長的製造商網路能夠選擇最佳工作來填補產能。該公司的基於雲端的服務套件和 Thomasnet 工業採購平台可協助製造商和工業服務供應商利用廣告、行銷和金融服務發展業務。它透過以下地理部門運作：美國和國際。該公司由 Laurence Zuriff 和 Randolph Altschuler 於 2013 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州北貝塞斯達。

info.description: Drugs Made In America Acquisition II Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or other similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 23, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

Launchpad Cadenza Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or other similar business combination, involving one or more businesses or assets. The company was founded on June 27, 2025 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Launchpad Cadenza Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是實現涉及一項或多項業務或資產的合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或其他類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月27日，總部位於加州奧克蘭。

info.description: Utah Medical Products, Inc. engages in the manufacturing, developing, and marketing of disposable and reusable medical devices. It focuses on the healthcare of women and babies. The firm's products are used for blood pressure monitoring and blood collection, electrosurgery, gynecology, neonatal critical care, perinatology, and urology. The company was founded on April 21, 1978 and is headquartered in Midvale, UT.
info.description_zh: Utah Medical Products, Inc. 從事一次性和可重複使用醫療設備的製造、開發和行銷。它專注於婦女和嬰兒的保健。該公司的產品用於血壓監測和血液採集、電外科、婦科、新生兒重症監護、圍產期和泌尿科。該公司成立於 1978 年 4 月 21 日，總部位於猶他州米德維爾。

info.description: First Trust IndXX NextG ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Indxx 5G & NextG Thematic Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that have devoted, or have committed to devote, material resources to the research, development and application of fifth generation ("5G") and next generation digital cellular technologies as they emerge.
info.description_zh: First Trust IndXX NextG ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 Indxx 5G 和 NextG 主題指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在追蹤那些已投入或已承諾投入物質資源用於第五代（「5G」）和下一代數位蜂窩技術的研究、開發和應用的公司的表現。

info.description: eBay, Inc. is a commerce company, whose platforms include an online marketplace and its localized counterparts, including off-platform businesses in Japan, as well as eBay's suite of mobile apps. It offers a platform for various product categories, including parts and accessories, collectibles, fashion, electronics, and home & garden. eBay generates revenue mainly through fees from sales, payment processing, and advertising. The company was founded by Pierre Morad Omidyar in September 1995 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.

NextTrip, Inc. engages in the provision of travel technology solutions. It connects people to new places and discoveries by utilizing digital media engagement, seasoned planning expertise, and unique inventory to curate custom vacations across the globe. The company was founded on December 23, 1985 and is headquartered in Sunrise, FL.

Lakefront Biotherapeutics is a biotechnology company, which engages in the identification and development of small molecule and antibody therapies. Its clinical pipeline includes filgotinib, GLP3667, Toledo program, and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The company was founded by Onno van de Stolpe, Rudi Pauwels, and Helmuth van Es on June 30, 1999 and is headquartered in Mechelen, Belgium.
info.description_zh: Lakefront Biotherapeutics 是一家生物技術公司，從事小分子和抗體療法的鑑定和開發。其臨床管線包括filgotinib、GLP3667、Toledo計畫、特發性肺纖維化等。該公司由 Onno van de Stolpe、Rudi Pauwels 和 Helmuth van Es 於 1999 年 6 月 30 日創立，總部位於比利時梅赫倫。

info.description: Performance Shipping, Inc. engages in the provision of shipping transportation services through its ownership of containerships. Its vessels are employed on time charters with liner companies carrying containerized cargo along worldwide shipping routes. The firm operates through the following segments: Tankers Vessels and Containers Vessels. Its fleet includes the following vessels: Sagitta, CEntaurus, New Jersey, Pamina, Domingo, Puelo, Pucon, March, Great, Hamburg, and Rotterdam. The company was founded on January 7, 2010 and is headquartered in Athens, Greece.

Richmond Mutual Bancorporation, Inc. operates as the holding company of First Bank Richmond. It aims to own all of the outstanding shares of capital stock of First Bank Richmond. The company was founded in 1887 and is headquartered in Richmond, IN.

info.description: Westport Fuel Systems, Inc. engages in the business of engineering, manufacturing, and supplying alternative fuel systems and components for transportation applications. It operates through the following segments: Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM), Independent Aftermarket (IAM), and Corporate. The OEM segment includes designing, manufacturing, and selling alternative fuel systems, components, and electronics including the HPDI 2.0 fuel systems product and engineering services. The IAM segment focuses on alternative fuel systems and components that consumers can purchase and have installed onto vehicles to use liquid petroleum or compressed natural gas fuels in addition to gasoline. The Corporate segment is involved in public company activities, corporate oversight, financing, capital allocation, and general administrative duties such as securing intellectual property. The company was founded on March 20, 1995 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. is an international energy and petrochemical company, which creates solutions that improve quality of life and meets society's evolving needs. The company is headquartered in Spring, TX.

Avnet, Inc. engages in the provision of distribution and sale of electronic components. It operates through the Electronic Components and Farnell segments. The Electronic Components segment markets and sells semiconductors, interconnect, passive and electromechanical devices, and integrated components. The Farnell segment focuses on the distribution of electronic components and related products to the electronic system design community utilizing multi-channel sales and marketing resources. The company was founded by Charles Avnet in 1921 and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Avnet, Inc. 從事電子元件的分銷和銷售業務。它透過電子元件部門和派睿電子部門運作。電子元件部門行銷和銷售半導體、互連、被動和機電設備以及整合元件。 Farnell 部門專注於利用多通路銷售和行銷資源向電子系統設計界分銷電子元件和相關產品。該公司由 Charles Avnet 於 1921 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州菲尼克斯。

info.description: Direxion Daily XOM Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of XOM. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of XOM and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to XOM, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily XOM Bull 2X Shares 尋求 XOM 每日表現的 200%（未計費用和開支）的每日投資結果。在正常情况下，该基金将至少 80% 的净资产（加上任何用于投资目的的借款）投资于 XOM 证券以及掉期协议和期权等金融工具，这些金融工具结合起来为 XOM 提供 2 倍的每日杠杆敞口，这与基金的投资目标一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Incannex Healthcare, Inc. is a biotech company, which engages in developing cannabinoid and psychedelic compound medicines. It focuses on the research and development for medicinal cannabis pharmaceutical products and psychedelic medicine therapies for treatment of a range of indications. The company was founded on April 27, 2001 and is headquartered in Norwest, Australia.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Incannex Healthcare, Inc.是一家生技公司，致力於開發大麻素和迷幻化合物藥物。它專注於藥用大麻藥物和用於治療一系列適應症的迷幻藥物療法的研究和開發。該公司成立於2001年4月27日，總部位於澳洲諾韋斯特。

info.description: Veritone, Inc. engages in the provision of artificial intelligence (AI) computing solutions to media and entertainment, government, and legal and compliance industries. It operates through the following segments: Advertising, aiWARE SaaS Solutions, and aiWARE Content Licensing and Media Services. The Advertising segment places advertisements for clients, primarily with radio broadcasters, podcasters and digital media producers. The aiWARE SaaS Solutions segment offers solutions through a combination of its direct sales force and indirect channel partners, such as value-added resellers (VARs), distributors, system integrators, managed services providers, and referral partners. The aiWARE Content Licensing and Media Services segment sells and markets activities relating to its digital content licensing services business through its direct sales force. The company was founded by Chad Edward Steelberg and Ryan S. Steelberg on June 13, 2014 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Veritone, Inc. 致力於為媒體和娛樂、政府以及法律和合規產業提供人工智慧 (AI) 運算解決方案。該公司透過以下部門運作：廣告部門、aiWARE SaaS 解決方案部門以及 aiWARE 內容授權和媒體服務部門。廣告部門為客戶投放廣告，主要是廣播公司、播客和數位媒體製作商。 aiWARE SaaS 解決方案部門透過其直接銷售人員和間接通路合作夥伴（例如加值經銷商 (VAR)、經銷商、系統整合商、主機服務供應商和推薦合作夥伴）的結合提供解決方案。 aiWARE 內容授權和媒體服務部門透過其直銷團隊銷售和行銷與其數位內容授權服務業務相關的活動。該公司由 Chad Edward Steelberg 和 Ryan S. Steelberg 於 2014 年 6 月 13 日創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Humana Inc. engages in the provision of health insurance services. It operates through the Insurance and CenterWell segments. The Insurance segment consists of Medicare benefits, marketed to individuals or directly via group Medicare accounts, as well as contract with CMS to administer the Limited Income Newly Eligible Transition, or LI-NET, prescription drug plan program and contracts with various states to provide Medicaid, dual eligible demonstration, and Long-Term Support Services benefits, which refer to as state-based contracts. The CenterWell segment represents payor-agnostic healthcare services offerings, including pharmacy dispensing services, provider services, and home services. The company was founded by David A. Jones, Sr., and Wendell Cherry on August 18, 1961 and is headquartered in Louisville, KY.

info.description: Symbotic, Inc. is an automation technology company, which engages in a robotics and automation-based product movement technology platform. It focuses on developing, commercializing, and deploying innovative, end-to-end technology solutions for supply chain operations. It operates through the United States and Canada geographical segments. The company was founded by Richard B. Cohen on December 11, 2020 and is headquartered in Wilmington, MA.
info.description_zh: Symbotic, Inc.是一家自動化技術公司，從事機器人和基於自動化的產品移動技術平台。它專注於為供應鏈營運開發、商業化和部署創新的端到端技術解決方案。它透過美國和加拿大的地理部門開展業務。該公司由 Richard B. Cohen 於 2020 年 12 月 11 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州威爾明頓。

info.description: The Pennant Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of healthcare services to patients of all ages. It operates through the Home Health and Hospice Services, and Senior Living Services segments. The Home Health and Hospice Services segment provides a combination of clinical care services such as nursing, speech, occupational and physical therapy, medical social work, and home health aide services. The Senior Living Services segment deals with assisted and independent living and memory care businesses. The company was founded on January 24, 2019 and is headquartered in Eagle, ID.

Tenable Holdings, Inc. engages in the development of security software solutions. The firm offers Cyber Exposure which is a discipline for managing and measuring cybersecurity risk in the digital era. Its products include tenable.io, tenable.sc, tenable.ot, and nessus professional. The firm delivers solutions in the field of application security, cloud security, compliance, energy, finance, healthcare, and retail. It operates through the following geographical segments: The Americas, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and Asia Pacific. The company was founded by John C. Huffard, Jr. and Renaud M. Deraison in 2002 and is headquartered in Columbia, MD.
info.description_zh: Tenable Holdings, Inc. 從事安全軟體解決方案的開發。該公司提供 Cyber​​ Exposure，這是一門用於管理和衡量數位時代網路安全風險的學科。其產品包括 tenable.io、tenable.sc、tenable.ot 和 nessus professional。該公司提供應用安全、雲端安全、合規性、能源、金融、醫療保健和零售領域的解決方案。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲以及亞太地區。該公司由 John C. Huffard, Jr. 和 Renaud M. Deraison 於 2002 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州哥倫比亞。

info.description: Neurosense Therapeutics Ltd. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages n the discovery and development of targeted therapeutics for neurodegenerative diseases. The firm offers PrimeC, a therapy for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). It also conducts testing of product candidates for the treatment of Parkinson's and Alzheimer's diseases. The company was founded by Alon Ben-Noon on February 13, 2017 and is headquartered in Herzliya, Israel.

Cybin, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company on a mission to create safe and effective psychedelic-based therapeutics to address the large unmet need for new and innovative treatment options for people who suffer from mental health conditions. It is currently developing CYB003, a proprietary deuterated psilocybin analog for the treatment of major depressive disorder and CYB004, a proprietary deuterated DMT molecule for generalized anxiety disorder and has a research pipeline of investigational psychedelic-based compounds. The company was founded by Paul Glavine, Eric So, and John Kanakis on October 13, 2016 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

Treasure Global, Inc. engages in the provision of payment solutions. The firm created an online-to-offline (O2O) e-commerce platform business model offering consumers and merchants instant rebates and affiliate cashback programs. It operates through the ZCITY Platform and Customized Software Development Service segments. The company was founded by Kok Pin Tan on March 20, 2020 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. is a global edge-to-cloud company, which engages in the provision of information technology, technology and enterprise products, solutions, and services. It operates through the following segments: Server, Hybrid Cloud, Intelligent Edge, Financial Services, and Corporate Investments and Other. The Server segment consists of general-purpose servers for multi-workload computing and workload-optimized servers to deliver the performance and value for demanding applications, and integrated systems comprised of software and hardware designed to address high-performance computing and supercomputing, artificial intelligence, data analytics, and transaction processing workloads for government and commercial customers globally. The Hybrid Cloud segment is involved in a variety of cloud-native and hybrid solutions across storage, private cloud, and the infrastructure software-as-a-service space. The Intelligent Edge segment offers wired and wireless local area networks, campus, branch, and data center switching, software-defined wide-area-networks, private and public cellular network software, network security, and associated services that enable secure connectivity for businesses of any size. The Financial Services segment provides investment solutions, such as leasing, financing, IT consumption, utility programs, and asset management services for customers that facilitate technology deployment models and the acquisition of complete IT solutions, including hardware, software, and services from Hewlett Packard Enterprise and others. The Corporate Investments and Other segment includes the Advisory and Professional Services business, which primarily offers consultative-led services, HPE and partner technology expertise and advice, implementation services, as well as complex solution engagement capabilities, the Communications and Media Solutions business, which primarily offers software and related services to the telecommunications industry, and Hewlett Packard Labs, which is responsible for research and development. The company was founded by William R. Hewlett and David Packard on July 2, 1939 and is headquartered in Spring, TX.
info.description_zh: 惠普企業有限公司是一家全球邊緣到雲端公司，從事提供資訊科技、技術和企業產品、解決方案和服務。它透過以下部門運作：伺服器部門、混合雲部門、智慧邊緣部門、金融服務部門以及企業投資及其他部門。伺服器部門包括用於多工作負載運算的通用伺服器和工作負載優化伺服器，為要求苛刻的應用程式提供效能和價值，以及由軟體和硬體組成的整合系統，旨在為全球政府和商業客戶解決高效能運算和超級運算、人工智慧、數據分析和事務處理工作負載。混合雲部門涉及跨儲存、私有雲和基礎設施軟體即服務領域的各種雲端原生和混合解決方案。智慧邊緣部門提供有線和無線區域網路、園區、分公司和資料中心交換、軟體定義的廣域網路、專用和公共蜂窩網路軟體、網路安全以及相關服務，為任何規模的企業提供安全連線。金融服務部門為客戶提供投資解決方案，例如租賃、融資、IT消費、公用事業計劃和資產管理服務，以促進技術部署模型和從慧與等公司購買完整的IT解決方案，包括硬體、軟體和服務。企業投資和其他部門包括諮詢和專業服務業務（主要提供諮詢主導的服務、慧與和合作夥伴技術專業知識和建議、實施服務以及複雜的解決方案參與能力）、通訊和媒體解決方案業務（主要向電信行業提供軟體和相關服務）以及惠普實驗室（負責研發）。該公司由 William R. Hewlett 和 David Packard 於 1939 年 7 月 2 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州斯普林。

info.description_zh: Direxion Daily AMZN Bear 1X Shares 尋求與 Amazon.com, Inc. 每日業績相反（或相反）100% 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金將與主要全球金融機構簽訂一項或多項掉期協議，根據該協議，該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換該基金在 AMZN 的投資所賺取的回報，該回報每天等於該基金淨資產價值的 -100%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Arcutis Biotherapeutics, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of treatments for dermatological diseases. Future FinTech Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the operation of a real name blockchain based e-commerce platform. Its activities include a blockchain-based online shopping mall platform, Chain Cloud Mall (CCM), a cross-border e-commerce platform (NONOGIRL), an incubator for blockchain based application projects, and a digital payment system (DCON). It operates through the following segments: Supply Chain Financing/Trading, Brokerage Service, and Others. The company was founded on June 29, 1998 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Future FinTech Group, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事基於實名區塊鏈的電子商務平台的營運。其活動包括基於區塊鏈的線上購物中心平台Chain Cloud Mall（CCM）、跨境電子商務平台（NONOGIRL）、基於區塊鏈的應用專案孵化器以及數位支付系統（DCON）。它透過以下部門運作：供應鏈融資/貿易、經紀服務和其他。該公司成立於1998年6月29日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: PS International Group Ltd. engages in providing logistics and supply chain solutions. The company was founded on September 12, 2023 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: PS International Group Ltd. 致力於提供物流和供應鏈解決方案。該公司成立於2023年9月12日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Vince Holding Corp. engages in the manufacture, design, and sale of luxury apparel and accessories. It operates through the following segments: Wholesale, Direct-to-Consumer, and Rebecca Taylor and Parker. The Wholesale segment deals with the sale of products to premier department stores and specialty stores in the U.S. and in selected international markets. The Direct-to-Consumer segment includes retail and outlet stores and its e-commerce business. The company was founded by Rea Laccone and Christopher LaPolice in 2002 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Vince Holding Corp. 從事奢華服裝和配件的製造、設計和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：批發部門、直接面向消費者部門以及麗貝卡泰勒和帕克部門。批發部門負責向美國和選定的國際市場的頂級百貨公司和專賣店銷售產品。直接面向消費者部門包括零售店和直銷店及其電子商務業務。該公司由 Rea Laccone 和 Christopher LaPolice 於 2002 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Gloo Holdings, Inc. operates as a technology platform for the faith and flourishing ecosystem, providing values-based AI, resources, insights and funding so people and communities flourish and organizations thrive. The company was founded on May 9, 2025 and is headquartered in Boulder, CO.

Global Engine Group Holding Ltd. engages in the provision of information and communication technology services. Its solutions include ICT solution services, technical services, and project management services. The company was founded by Yat Lung Lee on May 3, 2018 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Global Engine Group Holding Ltd. 從事提供資訊和通訊技術服務。其解決方案包括ICT解決方案服務、技術服務和專案管理服務。該公司由李逸龍於2018年5月3日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Vera Bradley, Inc. engages in the business of designing women's handbags, luggage, travel items, fashion, home accessories, and unique gifts. It operates through the following segments: Vera Bradley (VB) Direct and Vera Bradley Indirect. The VB Direct segment is involved in sale of VB products through full-line and factory outlet stores, websites, online outlet sites, and the VB annual outlet sale. The VB Indirect segment includes distribution of branded products to specialty retailers, select department stores, national accounts, third-party e-commerce sites, third-party inventory liquidators, and licensing agreements. The company was founded by Barbara Bradley Baekgaard and Patricia R. Miller in 1982 and is headquartered in Roanoke, IN.

Super League Enterprise, Inc. creates innovative and immersive entertainment experiences, platform and audience monetization and dynamic content feeding channels across the world's top gaming platforms. Fueled by an insatiable desire to stay on the forefront of this ever-evolving meta landscape, Super League pioneer's proprietary digital solutions provide unparalleled access to the global gaming audience. It also creates vibrant in-game communities through the development of innovative experiences and custom content, delivering powerful opportunities for brands and advertisers to achieve impactful insights, and marketing outcomes with audiences of all ages. The company was founded by John C. Miller, David Steigelfest, and Brett Morris on October 1, 2014 and is headquartered in Santa Monica, CA.
info.description_zh: Super League Enterprise, Inc. 在全球頂級遊戲平台上創造創新和沈浸式娛樂體驗、平台和受眾貨幣化以及動態內容供給管道。在不斷發展的元景觀中保持領先地位的永不滿足的願望的推動下，超級聯賽先鋒的專有數位解決方案為全球遊戲觀眾提供了無與倫比的訪問機會。它還透過開發創新體驗和客製化內容來創建充滿活力的遊戲內社區，為品牌和廣告商提供強大的機會，以獲得有影響力的見解，並為所有年齡段的受眾帶來行銷成果。該公司由 John C. Miller、David Steigelfest 和 Brett Morris 於 2014 年 10 月 1 日創立，總部位於加州聖莫尼卡。

info.description: VerifyMe, Inc. engages in the provision of software driven predictive analytics logistics. It operates through the Precision Logistics and Authentication segments. The Precision Logistics segment specializes in predictive analytics for optimizing delivery of time and temperature sensitive perishable products. The Authentication segment focuses on the anti-counterfeit and brand protection. The company was founded by Norman A. Gardner on November 10, 1999 and is headquartered in Lake Mary, FL.

info.description_zh: Cayson Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2024年5月27日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST 20Y+ Treasuries ETF seeks to generate an enhanced, high-frequency income stream by executing an options-based strategy focused primarily on selling short-term put options on leveraged exchange-traded funds that track three times the daily performance of its long-term Treasury benchmark. info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST 20Y+國債ETF旨在透過執行基於選擇權的策略來產生增強的高頻收入流，該策略主要側重於出售槓桿交易所交易基金的短期看跌期權，該基金追踪其長期國債基準日表現的三倍。該基金的目標是為其標的指數發行標準選擇權所產生的溢價收入的三倍，將優化的分配收益率與二級、有上限的利率參與和可自由支配的下行保護層相結合。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST QQQ ETF seeks current income; the fund's secondary investment objective being exposure to the performance of the ProShares UltraPro QQQ (NASDAQ: TQQQ) subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks current income while maintaining the opportunity for an indirect exposure to the share price of the ProShares UltraPro QQQ, subject to a limit on potential gains from increases in the price of the underlying ETF's shares. The fund is non-diversified.

Its proprietary multiomics discovery platform analyzes circulating cell-free DNA methylation patterns at single-base resolution alongside additional biomarkers to detect multiple cancers. The company was founded by Riley Ennis in 2014 and is headquartered in Brisbane, CA.

The company was founded by Peter Georgiopoulos and Leonard Vrondissis on July 25, 2025 and is headquartered in Millbrook, NY.

Globavend Holdings Ltd. is an e-commerce logistics provider offering end-to-end logistics solutions in Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand. The company's customers are primarily enterprise customers, e-commerce merchants, or operators of e-commerce platforms that offer business-to-consumer (B2C) transactions. It offers a one-stop solution, from pre-carriage parcel drop-off to parcel consolidation, air-freight forwarding, customs clearance, on-carriage parcel transportation, and delivery. The company was founded by Yau Wai Yiu in 2016 and is headquartered in Perth, Australia.

SPDR Galaxy Hedged Digital Asset Ecosystem ETF seeks to provide long term capital appreciation. The Sub-Adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing, directly or indirectly, in (i) equity securities of foreign and domestic companies within the crypto asset and blockchain industries, (ii) ETFs that primarily hold bitcoin and/or ether futures contracts, (iii) bitcoin and ether futures contracts, (iv) exchange-traded products that hold bitcoin or ether as a reference asset, and (v) covered call options and protective put options on investments held in the portfolio. IM Cannabis Corp. engages in the production and sale of medical cannabis products. It offers dry flower products and cannabis oil products under the IMC brand. The company was founded on March 7, 1980 and is headquartered in Glil Yam, Israel.

info.description_zh: IM Cannabis Corp. 從事醫用大麻產品的生產和銷售。它以 IMC 品牌提供乾燥花產品和大麻油產品。該公司成立於1980年3月7日，總部位於以色列Glil Yam。

info.description: Research Frontiers, Inc. engages in development, licensing and commercialization of suspended particle device (SPD) light-control technology for automobiles, homes, buildings, aircraft, boats, exhibition and display applications markets. It develops and licenses technologies to other companies that manufactures and markets SPD-smart chemical emulsion or light-control film made from chemical emulsion, lamination services and electronics to power end-products incorporating the film, skylights and sunroofs. The company was founded by Robert L. Saxe in October 1965 and is headquartered in Woodbury, NY.

Siddhi Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company which was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded by Brian D. Finn on July 05, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

F/m Accumulator Ultrashort Treasury Fund is an actively managed fund-of-funds structured to capture institutional total returns from short-duration fixed-income instruments while completely eliminating recurring taxable distribution payouts to its shareholders. The strategy dynamically shifts capital among underlying registered exchange-traded funds holding U.S. government obligations with maturities under one year, deploying a disciplined tactical rotation out of underlying positions prior to their dividend record dates to allow asset growth to compound directly within the fund's net asset value.
info.description_zh: F/m Accumulator Ultrashort Treasury Fund 是一種主動管理的基金中的基金，其結構旨在獲取短期固定收益工具的機構總回報，同時完全消除向股東支付的經常性應稅分配支出。該策略在持有期限在一年以下的美國政府債券的基礎註冊交易所交易基金之間動態轉移資本，在股息記錄日期之前從基礎頭寸中部署嚴格的戰術輪換，以使資產增長直接在基金的資產淨值內實現複合增長。

Oxley Bridge Acquisition Ltd. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more business. The company was founded on August 6, 2024 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

Sizzle Acquisition Corp. II is a blank check company which was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 8, 2024 and is headquartered in Washington, DC.
info.description_zh: Sizzle Acquisition Corp. II 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2024年7月8日，總部位於華盛頓特區。

info.description: Simplify Tax Aware Diversified Income Strategy ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks capital appreciation by investing in a flexible, multi-strategy portfolio of income-linked instruments, targeting enhanced core fixed income, credit-hedged high yield, option-based income, equity income, and foreign currency strategies. The portfolio executes its exposures predominantly via total return swaps on asset-class-focused ETFs and U.S. Government securities, using a tax-aware framework with one-year contract maturities and minimization of distributions to optimize long-term capital gains and after-tax efficiency.

The Kroger Co. engages in the retail grocery business which includes retail pharmacies and fuel centers. Its brands include Big K, Smart Way, Heritage Farm, Simple Truth, and Simple Truth Organic. The company was founded by Barney Kroger in 1883 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.

Firefly Neuroscience, Inc. is an artificial intelligence (AI) technology company, which engages in developing neuroscientific solutions for mental illnesses and neurological disorders. It offers Brain Network Analytics (BNA) platform, a software as a medical solution for the diagnostic and treatment methods for conditions such as depression, dementia, anxiety disorders, concussions, and ADHD. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Kenmore, NY.

NetSol Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of information technology and enterprise software solutions. The firm activities include licensing, subscriptions, modification, enhancement, and support of its suite of financial applications under the brand name NFS Ascent. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. The company was founded by Najeeb Ullah Ghauri, Salim Ullah Ghauri, Naeem Ullah Ghauri, and Irfan Mustafa on March 18, 1997 and is headquartered in Encino, CA.

Quantum X Labs, Inc. engages in the provision of digital advertising platform that develops and markets a variety of technological platforms that automate, optimize, and monetize digital online campaigns. It operates through the Search and Digital Content segments. The Search segment focuses on developing technological software solutions that perform automation, optimization, and monetization of internet campaigns. The Digital Content segment refers to the creation and editing of content to generate revenues from advertising platforms such as Google, Facebook, Yahoo, and Apple. The company was founded by Lior Wayn on August 16, 1985 and is headquartered in Ramat Hachayal, Israel.

First Trust Large Cap US Equity Select ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq Riskalyze US Large Cap IndexTM. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the common stocks and real estate investment trusts ("REITs") that comprise the index. The index is designed to select dividend-paying securities issued by large capitalization U.S. companies.

Universal Electronics, Inc. engages in providing universal wireless control solutions for the home. Its offerings include Home Entertainment Products, Climate Control Solutions, Smart Home and Security Products, Software and Cloud Services and Intellectual Property and Licensing. Its brands include One For All and Ecolink. The company was founded on November 21, 1986 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.

C.H. Robinson Worldwide, Inc. engages in the provision of freight transportation services and logistics solutions. It operates through the following segments: North American Surface Transportation (NAST), Global Forwarding, and All Other and Corporate. The NAST segment provides freight transportation services across North America through a network of offices in the United States, Canada, and Mexico. The Global Forwarding segment focuses on the global logistics services through an international network of offices in North America, Europe, Asia, Australia, New Zealand, and South America. The All Other and Corporate segment includes Robinson Fresh and Managed Services segments, as well as other surface transportation outside of North America and other miscellaneous revenues and unallocated corporate expenses. The company was founded by Charles Henry Robinson in 1905 and is headquartered in Eden Prairie, MN.
info.description_zh: C.H. Robinson Worldwide, Inc. 從事提供貨運服務和物流解決方案。該公司透過以下部門運營：北美地面運輸部門 (NAST)、全球貨運部門以及所有其他部門和企業部門。 NAST 部門透過位於美國、加拿大和墨西哥的辦事處網路提供橫跨北美的貨運服務。全球貨運部門專注於透過北美、歐洲、亞洲、澳洲、紐西蘭和南美辦事處的國際網路提供全球物流服務。所有其他和企业部门包括 Robinson Fresh 和管理服务部门，以及北美以外的其他地面运输以及其他杂项收入和未分配的公司支出。該公司由 Charles Henry Robinson 於 1905 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州伊甸草原。

info.description: Frequency Electronics, Inc. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of precision time and frequency generation technology. It operates through the following business segments: FEI-NY and FEI-Zyfer. The FEI-NY segment provides precision time, frequency generation, and synchronization products and subsystems that are found on-board satellites, in ground-based communication stations, and imbedded in moving platforms. The FEI-Zyfer segment designs, develops, and manufactures products for precision time and frequency generation and synchronization, primarily incorporating GPS technology. The company was founded by Martin B. Bloch on August 25, 1961 and is headquartered in Uniondale, NY.

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long NET Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of NET. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of NET, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.

Allot Ltd. engages in the provision of network intelligence and security solutions. The firm's solutions turn network, application, usage, and security data into intelligence. Its products include Allot Secure, Allot Smart, Application Control Gateway, DDoS Secure, and NFV Compliant. The company was founded by Yigal Jacoby and Michael Shurman on November 12, 1996 and is headquartered in Hod-Hasharon, Israel.

DaVita, Inc. engages in the provision of medical care services. It operates through the US Dialysis and Related Lab Services, and Other-Ancillary Services and Strategic Initiatives segments. The US Dialysis and Related Lab Services segment offer kidney dialysis services in the United States for patients suffering from chronic kidney failure. The Other-Ancillary Services and Strategic Initiatives segment consists primarily of pharmacy services, disease management services, vascular access services, clinical research programs, physician services, direct primary care, end stage renal disease seamless care organizations, and comprehensive care. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.

Global Interactive Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of a global multi-media platform for users to interact with other like-minded users to share appreciation of various types of entertainment and cultures such as K-POP and modern Korean culture. It operates through the FANTOO platform. The company was founded on October 20, 2021 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.

Oxbridge Re Holdings Ltd. engages in the provision of property and casualty reinsurance in the Gulf Coast region of the United States. Through its subsidiaries, it fully collateralizes policies to cover property losses from specified catastrophes. The company was founded by Sanjay Madhu on April 4, 2013 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.

info.description: FGI Industries Ltd. engages in the supply of kitchen and bath products. Its products fall under the following categories: Sanitaryware, Bath Furniture, Shower Systems and Other. The Sanitaryware category offers bath products such as toilets, sinks, pedestals and toilet seats. The Bath Furniture category deals with wood and wood-substitute furniture for bathrooms, including vanities, mirrors, laundry and medicine cabinets, and other storage systems. The Shower Systems category includes a range of shower-related products such as shower walls, shower doors and shower basins. The Other category includes shower door and shower systems products, custom kitchen cabinetry, and other accessory items. The company was founded on May 26, 2021 and is headquartered in East Hanover, NJ.
info.description_zh: FGI Industries Ltd. 從事廚房和浴室產品的供應。其產品分為以下類別：衛浴設備、浴室家具、淋浴系統及其他。衛浴產品類別提供馬桶、水槽、底座和馬桶座圈。浴室家具類別涉及浴室的木質和木質替代家具，包括梳妝台、鏡子、洗衣櫃和藥櫃以及其他儲存系統。淋浴系統類別包括一系列與淋浴相關的產品，例如淋浴牆、淋浴門和淋浴盆。其他類別包括淋浴門和淋浴系統產品、客製化廚房櫥櫃和其他配件。該公司成立於2021年5月26日，總部位於新澤西州東漢諾威。

info.description: Aethlon Medical, Inc. is a medical technology company which focuses on developing products to diagnose and treat life and organ threatening diseases. It develops Aethlon Hemopurifier, which is a clinical-stage immunotherapeutic device designed to combat cancer and life-threatening viral infections. The firm operates through the following segments: Aethlon and ESI. The Aethlon segment is involved in therapeutic business activities. The ESI segment consists of diagnostic business activities. The company was founded by James A. Joyce on April 17, 1991 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Aethlon Medical, Inc. 是一家醫療技術公司，專注於開髮用於診斷和治療威脅生命和器官的疾病的產品。該公司開發了 Aethlon Hemopurifier，這是一種臨床階段的免疫治療設備，旨在對抗癌症和危及生命的病毒感染。該公司透過以下部門運作：Aethlon 和 ESI。 Aethlon 部門從事治療業務活動。 ESI 部門包括診斷業務活動。該公司由 James A. Joyce 於 1991 年 4 月 17 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: ICZOOM Group, Inc. is an offshore holding company, which engages in the sale of electronic component products through its B2B e-commerce platform. It also provides services such as temporary warehousing, logistics and shipping, and customs clearance. The company was founded by Lei Xia and Duan Rong Liu on June 18, 2015 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: ICZOOM Group, Inc.是一家離岸控股公司，透過其B2B電子商務平台從事電子元件產品的銷售。並提供臨時倉儲、物流運輸、報關等服務。該公司由夏雷和劉段榮於2015年6月18日創立，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Sports Entertainment Gaming Global Corp. engages in the provision of domestic and international lottery products and services. It develops and operates a platform which enables the remote purchase of legally sanctioned lottery games. The company was founded by Lawrence Anthony DiMatteo III and Matthew Allen Clemenson on March 17, 2016 and is headquartered in Fort Worth, TX.

info.description: Rocket One, Inc. engages in the development of new generation therapies for dermatological disorders. Its product pipeline focuses on potential treatments for indications including atopic dermatitis (also known as eczema), chronic wounds, psoriasis, asthma, and acne. It offers the BioLexa Platform, a drug compound platform for the treatment of eczema. The company was founded by Robbie Knie, Matthew D. Eitner, and James Ahern on May 16, 2017 and is headquartered in Hoboken, NJ.

YYForce Ltd. operates as an AI-native workforce management platform, which engages in providing integrated facility management (IFM). Its platform, YY Circle, offers solutions for hospitality, food and beverage, retail, and other service sectors to predict, plan, and optimize workforce deployment. The company was founded by Fu Xiao Wei and Zhang Fan in December 2010 and is headquartered in Singapore.

Turbo Energy SA provides energy solutions. It engages in the developing, manufacturing and distributing of photovoltaic products. The company was founded on September 18, 2013 and is headquartered in Valencia, Spain.
info.description_zh: Turbo Energy SA 提供能源解決方案。它從事光伏產品的開發、製造和銷售。該公司成立於2013年9月18日，總部位於西班牙巴倫西亞。

info.description: Nuwellis, Inc. operates as a medical device company. It engages in the provision of products for the treatment of fluid overload. The firm's products include Aquadex FlexFlow System, which provides an ultrafiltration for the removal of salt and water in patients with hypervolemia, or fluid overload. It operates through Cardiac and Coronary Disease Products segment. The company was founded by Crispin Marsh and William S. Peters in November 1999 and is headquartered in Eden Prairie, MN.
info.description_zh: Nuwellis, Inc. 是一家醫療器材公司。它從事提供治療液體超負荷的產品。該公司的產品包括 Aquadex FlexFlow 系統，​​該系統提供超濾功能，用於去除血液體積過多或液體超負荷患者的鹽和水。它透過心臟和冠心病產品部門運作。該公司由 Crispin Marsh 和 William S. Peters 於 1999 年 11 月創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州伊甸園草原。

info.description: Tempest Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage oncology company advancing a diverse portfolio of small molecule product candidates containing tumor-targeted and/or immune-mediated mechanisms with the potential to treat a wide range of tumors. The company's novel programs range from early research to later-stage investigation in a randomized global study in first-line cancer patients. Tempest Therapeutics was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Brisbane, CA.
info.description_zh: Tempest Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的腫瘤公司，致力於開發多種小分子候選產品組合，其中包含腫瘤靶向和/或免疫介導機制，具有治療多種腫瘤的潛力。該公司的新穎項目涵蓋從早期研究到針對第一線癌症患者的隨機全球研究的後期調查。 Tempest Therapeutics 成立於 2011 年，總部位於加州布里斯班。

info.description: Veea, Inc. is a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) company, which engages in the sale of smart computing hubs and related subscriptions and licenses. Its solutions include digital inclusion, connected buildings, precision agriculture, TROLLEE, and Internet-of-Things (IoT) and Industrial internet of things (IIoT) connectivity. The company was founded by Allen B. Salmasi and Michael Salmasi in 2014 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Veea, Inc. 是一家平台即服務 (PaaS) 公司，從事智慧運算中心及相關訂閱和授權的銷售。其解決方案包括數位包容、互聯建築、精準農業、TROLLEE、物聯網 (IoT) 和工業物聯網 (IIoT) 連接。該公司由 Allen B. Salmasi 和 Michael Salmasi 於 2014 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Tenon Medical, Inc. is a medical device company, which engages in the development of a minimally invasive approach to the sacroiliac joint (SI joint) using a single titanium implant for treatment of the most common types of SI Joint disorders. The company was founded by Richard Ferrari and Richard Ginn on June 19, 2012 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, CA.
info.description_zh: Tenon Medical, Inc. 是一家醫療器材公司，致力於開發骶髂關節（SI 關節）微創方法，使用單一鈦植入物來治療最常見的 SI 關節疾病。該公司由 Richard Ferrari 和 Richard Ginn 於 2012 年 6 月 19 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州洛斯加托斯。

info.description: VS MEDIA Holdings Ltd. engages in the management of a global network of digital creators who create and publish content to social media platforms. It operates through the following segments: Marketing Services, Social Commerce, and Other. The Marketing Services segment is involved in providing affiliate marketing, product placement, and brand sponsorship deals for creators to promote brand's messages; and creating and publishing content on social media platforms. The Social Commerce segment resells brand's products to creators. The company was founded by Nga Fan Wong in 2013 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: VS MEDIA Holdings Ltd. 從事全球數位創作者網路的管理，這些創作者在社群媒體平台上創建和發佈內容。它透過以下部門運作：行銷服務、社交商務和其他。行銷服務部門為創作者提供聯盟行銷、產品置入和品牌贊助交易，以宣傳品牌訊息；在社群媒體平台上創建和發佈內容。社群商務部門將品牌產品轉售給創作者。該公司由黃雅帆於2013年創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Jinxin Technology Holding Co. engages in the provision of digital content services. It focuses on providing digital and integrated educational content. The company was founded by Jin Xu in 2014 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 金鑫科技控股有限公司從事提供數位內容服務。它專注於提供數位和整合的教育內容。該公司由金旭於2014年創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: ReTo Eco-Solutions, Inc. engages in the design, research and development, manufacturing, and sale of ecological and intelligent equipment. It provides comprehensive solid waste treatment solutions and equipment, and its applications also extend to the research, development, and production of mining equipment and smart craft beer machines. The company offers a full spectrum of products and solutions related to ecological environmental protection and intelligent equipment, ranging from solid waste treatment and mining equipment to smart craft beer sales systems. The company was founded by Li Heng Fang in 1999 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

Alliance Entertainment Holding Corp. engages in the distribution of music, movies, and consumer electronics. It distributes its physical media, entertainment products, hardware, and accessories through an established multi-channel strategy. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Plantation, FL.

info.description_zh: AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc.致力於建立一個融合人工智慧和區塊鏈、連接Web2和Web3的生態系統。其核心產品包括BesTrade DeAI Agent和AIxC生態產品。該公司成立於2004年3月29日，總部位於加州卡爾斯巴德。

info.description: Blue Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It engages in the effecting of a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on February 10, 2025 and is headquartered in Newport Beach, CA.

Biodexa Pharmaceuticals Plc is a drug delivery technology company. The firm is focused on the research and development of medicines for rare cancers, via both in-house programs as well as partnered programs. Its proprietary platform drug delivery technologies are Q-Sphera platform is a disruptive polymer microsphere technology, which is used for sustained release at the microscale to prolong and control the release of therapeutics over an extended period of time from weeks to months; Midasolve platform is an innovative nano saccharide technology, which is used to dissolve drugs at the nanoscale so that they can be administered in liquid form directly and locally into tumors; Midacore platform is an edge gold nanoparticle technology, which is used for targeting sites of disease at the nanoscale. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Cardiff, the United Kingdom.

info.description: BillionToOne, Inc. is a next-generation molecular diagnostics company on a mission to create powerful and accurate tests that are accessible to all. Its patented Quantitative Counting Templates (QCT) molecular counting platform is a multiplex technology capable of accurately counting DNA molecules at the single-molecule level. The was founded by Oguzhan Atay, Sukrit Silas, and David Tsao in 2016 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.

Basel Medical Group Ltd. is an investment holding company, which engages in providing orthopedic surgeries, medical care, and diagnosis services. Its services include orthopedic surgeries, medical care, rehabilitative therapy, physiotherapy, non-surgical treatments, medical diagnosis, magnetic resonance imaging, general surgery, x-ray, lump removal, sports medicine, and total hip replacement. The company was founded by Man Hing Yip on August 10, 2023 and is headquartered in Singapore.

CollPlant Biotechnologies Ltd. operates as a regenerative and aesthetic medicine company. It engages in the research, development, manufacture, and marketing of medical products for tissue repair such as bioprinting of tissues and organs, and medical aesthetics. Its products include VergenixSTR, VergenixFG, and Collink.3D. The company was founded by Oded Shoseyov in June 2004 and is headquartered in Rehovot, Israel.
info.description_zh: CollPlant Biotechnologies Ltd. 是一家再生和美容醫學公司。它從事組織器官生物列印、醫學美容等組織修復醫療產品的研究、開發、製造和行銷。其產品包括VergenixSTR、VergenixFG和Collink.3D。該公司由 Oded Shoseyov 於 2004 年 6 月創立，總部位於以色列雷霍沃特。

info.description: Central Plains Bancshares, Inc. engages in the offering of sale of shares of its common stock in connection with the conversion of Home Federal Savings from a mutual savings association to a stock savings association. The company was founded on June 13, 2023 and is headquartered in Grand Island, NE.

info.description: Corsair Gaming, Inc. designs and supplies hardware components for personal computers. It operates through the Gamer and Creator Peripherals, and Gaming Components and Systems segments. The Gamer and Creator Peripherals segment offers gaming keyboards, mice, headsets, controllers, and gaming gear including capture cards, Stream Decks, USB microphones, studio accessories, and EpocCam software, as well as coaching and training services. The Gaming Components and Systems segment focuses on creating power supply units, or PSUs, cooling solutions, computer cases, DRAM modules, prebuilt, and custom-built gaming PCs. The company was founded by Andrew J. Paul in 1994 and is headquartered in Milpitas, CA.

First Trust Nasdaq Lux Digital Health Solutions ETF seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield of an equity index called the Nasdaq Lux Health Tech Index TM (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is designed to measure the performance of a selection of companies that are primarily engaged in and involved at the intersection of healthcare and technology, as classified by Lux Capital based on analysis of the products and services offered by those companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust Nasdaq Lux Digital Health Solutions ETF 尋求與名為 Nasdaq Lux Health Tech Index TM（「指數」）的股票指數的價格和收益率大致相對應的結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在衡量主要從事醫療保健和技術交叉領域的精選公司的業績，Lux Capital 根據對這些公司提供的產品和服務的分析進行分類。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Bruker Corp. engages in the business of developing, manufacturing, and distributing high-performance scientific instruments and analytical and diagnostic solutions that enable customers to explore life and materials at microscopic, molecular, and cellular levels. It operates through the following segments: Bruker Scientific Instruments (BSI) BioSpin, BSI Chemicals, Applied Markets, Life Science, In-Vitro Diagnostics, Detection (CALID), BSI NANO, and Bruker Energy and Supercon Technologies (BEST). The BSI BioSpin segment includes life science tools based on magnetic resonance technology. The BSI CALID segment focuses on life science mass spectrometry and ion mobility spectrometry solutions, analytical and process analysis instruments, and solutions based on infrared and Raman molecular spectroscopy technologies and radiological and nuclear detectors for chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, and explosive detection. The BSI NANO segment offers advanced x-ray instruments, atomic force microscopy instrumentation, advanced fluorescence optical microscopy instruments, analytical tools for electron microscopes and x-ray metrology, defect-detection equipment for semiconductor process control, handheld, portable, and mobile x-ray fluorescence spectrometry instruments, spark optical emission spectroscopy systems, and chip cytometry products and services for targeted spatial proteomics, multi-omics services, and products and services for spatial genomics research. The BEST segment is involved in superconducting and non-superconducting materials and devices for use in renewable energy, energy infrastructure, healthcare, and big science research. The company was founded by Emil Bruker and Gunther Laukien in 1960 and is headquartered in Billerica, MA.

info.description: Global X NASDAQ 100 Collar 95-110 ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance,before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Collar 95-110 Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Collar 95-110 Index ("underlying index"). The underlying index measures the performance of a risk management strategy that holds the underlying stocks of the NASDAQ 100 Index and applies an options collar strategy (i.e., a mix of short (sold) call options and long (purchased) put options) on the NASDAQ 100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 Collar 95-110 ETF 尋求提供與 Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Collar 95-110 指數（「基礎指數」）的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於 Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Collar 95-110 指數（「基礎指數」）的證券。標的指數衡量持有納斯達克 100 指數標的股票的風險管理策略的績效，並對納斯達克 100 指數應用期權領策略（即空頭（賣出）看漲期權和多頭（買入）看跌期權的組合）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Agilent Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of application focused solutions for life sciences, diagnostics, and applied chemical markets. It operates through the following segments: Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets, Applied Markets, and Agilent CrossLab. The Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets segment offers active pharmaceutical ingredients for oligo-based therapeutics as well as solutions that include reagents, instruments, software and consumables. The Applied Markets segment refers to the application-focused solutions that include instruments and software that enable customers to identify, quantify, and analyze the physical and biological properties of substances and products. The Agilent CrossLab segment spans the entire lab with its extensive services and consumables portfolio in addition to software and laboratory automation solutions. The company was founded in May 1999 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
